items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: I know Rip's very well and I know Webber, his right hand partner, because I used to play for all the big bands that came to their club

ctx.x: Do you remember- I remember a guy named Rip Roberts? Remember Rip Roberts? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He did- he did one record for Rip. That one record. It was called, uh, Long-Hairs- Long-Hairs Boogie. Ballin' with Fess. And- what was the name? There was a flip side. You know it. I can't think. Got a whole lot of love for you. Got a whole-
